tool_input.command:
echo "TMPDIR=$TMPDIR" && mkdir -p "$TMPDIR/doc"
for f in CSVParser Lexer Token "Token.Type" "CSVParser.Builder" "CSVParser.CSVRecordIterator"; do
  out=$(echo "$f" | tr -d '.')
  sed -e 's/<[^>]*>/ /g' "api/org/apache/commons/csv/$f.html" | sed -e "s/ / /g; s/&/\&/g; s/</</g; s/>/>/g; s/"/\"/g; s/'/'/g" | sed '/^\s*$/d' > "$TMPDIR/doc/$out.txt"
done
wc -l "$TMPDIR"/doc/*.txt
tool_input.description: Extract readable text from javadoc HTML files into TMPDIR

result:
All three self-contained test classes are in place under `tests/org/apache/commons/csv/` and `./compile.sh` reports success:

- **`TokenAgentTest`** — covers `Token`'s fields (`content`, `type`, `isReady`, `isQuoted`, `isEscaped`), the default/initialized state, `reset()`, `toString()`, and the `Token.Type` enum (`values()`, `valueOf()` including null/unknown/case-sensitivity errors, ordinals).
- **`CSVParserAgentTest`** — covers all static `parse(...)` factories (including null-argument contract errors), the deprecated constructors, `Builder` fluent methods, `close()`/`isClosed()`, `iterator()`/`stream()` behavior (including post-close semantics), `nextRecord()`, line/record numbers, `getFirstEndOfLine()`, header map/names, and header/trailer comments.
- **`LexerAgentTest`** — covers `close()`/`isClosed()`, position/line tracking, `getFirstEol()`, the `isXxx` predicate methods, full `nextToken()` tokenization sequences, `readEndOfLine()`, `readEscape()` (including the end-of-stream error case), and `trimTrailingSpaces()`.

Note: since `CSVFormat`, `CSVRecord`, and `ExtendedBufferedReader` have no javadoc in `api/` (only `CSVParser`, `Lexer`, and `Token` do), I used their well-established, stable public API as scaffolding — validated by letting `./compile.sh` itself confirm each assumption compiles against the real `lib/project.jar`, rather than inspecting the jar directly.
